---
title: "Best trait estimates"
---

```{python}
from _lib import *
best = read("best_config")
bsum = read("best_estimates")
```

Objective B needs the best available trait estimate for every leaf, not a model comparison.
The best configuration (RTM × error model × data use) is chosen per trait and foreoptic
class:

* **Criterion:** the lowest log-CRPS against measurements on fresh leaves, which rewards
  accuracy and calibrated uncertainty.
* **Comparability:** only configurations fitted to all leaves of the group compete.
* **Honest error estimate:** the selection itself is evaluated by leave-one-dataset-out
  cross-validation (`lodo_crps_log`).

Leaves without measurements receive the estimate of the configuration selected for their
foreoptic class.

```{python}
if len(best):
    show_table(fmt(best.drop(columns=["scores"])))
else:
    no_data()
```

```{python}
if len(bsum):
    stats([(f"{bsum['observation_id'].nunique():,}", "leaves with best estimates"),
           (f"{bsum['trait'].nunique()}", "traits")])
```
